name: ProjectDossier/patient-trial-matching
what_it_is: A two-stage Python pipeline for matching patients to clinical trials: NER-based data enrichment of disease/drug mentions followed by BERT cross-encoder neural re-ranking. Published in JBI (2023).
constraints: Entity extraction takes 5-10 hours on CPU
Locked to Python 3.8 + specific medspaCy/spaCy versions
Data must be fetched via prepare_data.py first
